matrixDown: Chat cannot reach the Matrix server

auth.accountDetail: Your name, password and second factors.
auth.membersDetail: Who uses Chat, and their role: members talk, viewers also see the channels' rules and the file, admins also set the rules of channels people made, export for legal requests and manage members and tokens.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: passwords, and identity providers with OIDC.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts and other products, each with a role and an end date. Incidents needs one with the editor role to open channels.
auth.viewersOnly: Only viewers and admins see this
auth.viewersOnlyDetail: The channels' rules, the file and the integrations are for members with the viewer role or higher.

file.notApplied: The chat file on disk is not applied

channel.encryptedDetail: This conversation is end-to-end encrypted: only Element and other Matrix apps on your own devices can read and answer it.
channel.adminsPost: Only the channel's admins post here.
channel.noneDetail: Browse the channels open to the company, or start a direct message.

composer.hint: Files stay in your install. Shift and Enter for a new line.
composer.guestsSee: This channel has guests from {{company}}. Everything you send here, files too, they can see.
composer.guestsSeeAll: This channel has guests. Everything you send here, files too, they can see.

info.guestsSee: Guests see only this channel. Their access ends on {{date}} unless {{who}} invites them again.
info.hold: Legal hold {{reference}}: nothing here is deleted until the hold is released.
info.encrypted: End-to-end encrypted: search, exports and these pages cannot read its messages.
info.noPins: Nothing pinned. Pin a message in Element to keep it here.

browse.title: Channels
browse.description: Channels open to the company. Join one, or make a new one.
browse.name: Name
browse.privateDetail: Only people you add see it.

search.title: Search
search.description: Messages and files from channels open to the company and from the private channels and direct messages you are in.
search.label: Search messages and files
search.start: Type what you are looking for
search.startDetail: Words in messages, or a file's name.
search.noneDetail: Try fewer words or a wider date. Messages past a channel's retention are deleted and cannot be found.
search.narrowDetail: Type these in the search box, or use the fields.
search.covers1: Channels open to the company, even ones you have not joined
search.covers2: Private channels and direct messages you are in
search.covers3: File names; not the text inside files
search.covers4: Nothing past a channel's retention, nor end-to-end encrypted messages

people.title: People
people.description: Members and groups come from Identity. Guests are invited to single channels and leave when their access ends.
people.descriptionMatrix: Everyone with an account on the Matrix server. Set up Identity for names, groups and leavers.
people.name: Name
people.leavingDetail_one: Within five minutes {{name}} is taken out of {{count}} channel and signed out on every device. What they wrote stays, under each channel's retention.
people.leavingDetail_other: Within five minutes {{name}} is taken out of all {{count}} channels and signed out on every device. What they wrote stays, under each channel's retention.

guests.inviteDetail: Someone outside the company, to one channel that takes guests. They get a Matrix account that sees only that channel until the day it ends.
guests.name: Name
guests.daysHint: As long as the file allows
guests.noChannel: None of your channels takes guests
guests.noChannelDetail: An admin turns guests on for a channel under Channels, or in the chat file.
guests.invited: {{name}} is invited. Send them the welcome link below.
guests.linkDetail: Shown once. The guest chooses a password there and signs in to Element at {{homeserver}}.
guests.sees: {{channel}}, and direct messages with its members
guests.signsInElement: Element, with the password they chose
guests.notWelcomed: Has not opened the welcome link yet
guests.endConfirm: End {{name}}'s access now? They leave the channel and are signed out.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Company and team channels are set in chat.yaml with the rest of the install. People make their own channels too; retention and guests follow the rules here.
channels.deletes: Messages older than {{period}} are deleted at the Matrix server's next purge, within a day.
channels.guestsDetail: People outside the company see only the channels they are invited to.
channels.encrypted: End-to-end encrypted: retention still deletes, but search and exports cannot read its messages.
channels.inFileDetail: Changed in the file, reviewed like code; Chat reads it again within a minute.
channels.byProduct: Opened by {{by}}. Its members keep it; an admin sets its rules here.
channels.madeByMembers: Made by its members, not in chat.yaml.
channels.newDetail: A channel you make for a project or a team. You manage who joins it.

legal.title: Export for a legal request
legal.description: Exports every message, edit, reaction and file in the range as a signed archive. Starting one is recorded in the audit log with your name.
legal.holdDetail: Nothing in the channel is deleted, whatever the retention, until the hold is released.
legal.started: Export {{reference}} started for #{{channel}}, {{from}} to {{to}}. The archive appears below when it is ready.
legal.startedHold: Export {{reference}} started for #{{channel}}, {{from}} to {{to}}. Messages in the channel are on hold. The archive appears below when it is ready.
legal.released: Hold {{reference}} released: the channel's retention applies again.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The Matrix server Chat runs on, the directory, and the apps that post into channels.
integrations.matrixDetail: Synapse stores every message and file and delivers them to Element and other Matrix apps.
integrations.element: In Element on a phone or a computer, choose another server and enter {{homeserver}}; sign in with the company's identity provider.
integrations.identity: Names, groups for the file's channels, and leavers.
integrations.appsDetail: Apps of the file post into their channels through a webhook address, as their own account marked as an app.
integrations.hookMade: The webhook address for {{app}}. It is shown once; a new one ends the old one.
integrations.incidents: An incident gets its own channel: Incidents opens it with a Chat token with the editor role.
integrations.meet: A call starts from a channel or a person in Meet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Channels, retention, guests and apps, as {{file}} sets them.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change them in the file and review the change like code; Chat reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.empty: # No chat file yet: only the channels people make.
settings.channelsDetail: Made and kept in step on the Matrix server.
settings.syncFailed: The Matrix server is not in step with the file
settings.warnings: What the file names that the server or the directory does not have
settings.syncNow: Bring the server in step now

welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}
welcome.detail: You are invited to {{channel}} as a guest until {{date}}. Choose a password, then sign in with Element.
welcome.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
welcome.step1: Open Element on the web, or install it on your phone or computer.
welcome.step2: Choose to sign in on another server, and enter the address below.
welcome.step3: Sign in with the user and the password you chose.
welcome.gone: This link does not work any more
welcome.goneDetail: It was used already, or the guest's access ended. Ask whoever invited you for a new invitation.
